blocks.description: A diamond with the condition n > 0. If it is true the body runs and control returns to the diamond; if it is false the loop is left towards EndWhile. Beside it, the value of n goes down from 3 to 0.

caption.text: The question comes before the body. With
and the loop is left on the right.
